_comment: Second design (not from PULP), used to check the pipeline works on a block
it was not built around. To work on it: copy this file to config/project.json
(or paste it on the app's Project page), which rebuilds the knowledge base.
name: apb_timer — second design (non-PULP)

testbench.signals_note: irq is the DUT interrupt output (irq_o); rd (logic [31:0]) and hi (int) are scratch variables declared in the testbench. Register offset constants: CTRL, PRESCALE, COMPARE, COUNT, STATUS.
